run_fast_rcnn_inference_rotated: run rotated Fast R-CNN inference on a batch of images with score thresholding and NMS
run_fast_rcnn_inference_single_image_rot: run rotated Fast R-CNN inference on a single image with rotated NMS and score filtering
build_RotatedFastRCNNOutputLayers: build a RotatedFastRCNNOutputLayers predictor with a rotated Box2BoxTransform for rotated box regression
build_RROIHeads: build RROIHeads for rotated Fast R-CNN detection using ROIAlignRotated pooling and rotated box prediction
run_label_and_sample_proposals: run proposal labeling and sampling for RROIHeads training using pairwise rotated IoU matching
